item.title: Congressman asks FCC to investigate Bad Bunny for ‘F-word’ during halftime show
item.description: U.S. Representative Randy Fine, whose district includes portions of Marion County, has asked the Federal Communications Commission to investigate the Super Bowl LX halftime show, alleging the performance by Bad Bunny contained sexually suggestive content and vulgar language that violated federal broadcast regulations. Read more: Congressman asks FCC to investigate Bad Bunny for ‘F-word’ during halftime show

item.title: Patricia Scott
item.description: Patricia Scott was passionate about her relationship with Jesus. Patricia enjoyed sewing and during her later years after retirement, you would find her working out all sorts of puzzles and crocheting. Patricia lived a good life. She loved cooking. Read more: Patricia Scott

item.description: A new all-you-can-eat sushi restaurant is preparing to open its doors next month in a space along State Road 200 that was vacated by Yummy House last year. Read more: New all-you-can-eat sushi restaurant in Ocala taking over former Yummy House

item.title: Woman killed in head-on collision at Marion County intersection
item.description: A 34-year-old woman was killed and two other individuals were seriously injured after two vehicles swerved into each other at a Marion County intersection while attempting to evade a collision. Read more: Woman killed in head-on collision at Marion County intersection

item.title: Marion officials voting on food truck park after fierce resident opposition
item.description: Marion County officials will issue a decision next week on a proposed food truck park that has garnered opposition from over 100 residents, many of whom are concerned with the potential for added noise and traffic. Read more: Marion officials voting on food truck park after fierce resident opposition

item.title: Ocala wife intentionally hits husband with Jeep, deputies say
item.description: A 45-year-old Ocala woman has been charged with aggravated assault after she allegedly struck her husband with her Jeep while he was walking in their neighborhood. Read more: Ocala wife intentionally hits husband with Jeep, deputies say

item.title: I’m excited for Publix and Walmart in south Ocala, but I’d love a Hispanic supermarket and Cuban bakery.
item.description: "It is the best news I’ve heard about Marion County that is permitting the building of a new Publix and Walmart Supercenter along County Road 484. We are still missing more businesses, like a Spanish supermarket. Something like a Sedanos supermarket. Or a Cuban bakery like Cao or Pinecrest bakery." - A Marion Oaks resident shares her opinion. Read more: I’m excited for Publix and Walmart in south Ocala, but I’d love a Hispanic supermarket and Cuban bakery.
